description:
*FREE GUIDE: 📘 The Content Creator's AI Blueprint*  – https://FirstMovers.ai/blueprint/

*Beneath the quantum field, space and time are not fundamental. A physicist in Birmingham just sealed 24,000 atoms in a tiny universe with no clock, and time showed up anyway.*

Giovanni Barontini's cold-atom experiment ran in Physical Review Research this summer, and a Rome team followed on September 11 with a paper arguing time has built-in *fuzziness*. Stack that on Wheeler's 1967 equation and the *amplituhedron*, and the stage itself comes apart.

What you'll learn:
✅ Why *entropic time* only runs when something changes
✅ How entanglement stitches space together, and what happens at *zero*
✅ The 3-word answer Wheeler gave for what sits at the floor of reality

Wait until you see which layer of reality your *imagination* sits on.

#QuantumPhysics #Spirituality #Science

📚 SOURCES
Barontini, "Testing the problem of time with cold atoms," Physical Review Research (2026), University of Birmingham
title: Physicists Looked Beneath the Quantum Field. Space and Time Were Gone
